dict.string: GrindrX uses your location to show nearby profiles and to attach your position to a chat message when you choose to share it.
GrindrX uses the microphone only while you are recording a voice message, and only when you tap record.
GrindrX needs access to your photo library so you can pick images to send in a chat and to set your profile and album photos.
GrindrX needs the camera so you can take a photo to send in a chat or to set your profile and album photos.
